candidate.answerReason: The triangle has area 3×4÷2=6 cm². Using AB as the base gives 5h÷2=6, so the perpendicular distance h is 2.4 cm.

methods.label: Compute the area using two bases
methods.explanation: Let the distance from point \(C\) to \(AB\) be \(h\). Equating the areas gives \(1/2\times3\times4=1/2\times5\times h\), so \(h=12/5=2.4\).
methods.levelReason: Combines the Grade 7 distance definition with the primary-school triangle area formula and a simple equation.
